**1 — Scene:** An open-faced wholegrain bread meal with sliced cucumber and mushrooms.

**2 — Vessel:** A square plate, approximately **24 × 24 cm**. Its equivalent circular diameter is about **27 cm**, giving an area of **3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Wholegrain bread, cucumber slices, cooked mushrooms, and a possible light oil coating, estimated from the sheen.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Wholegrain bread | 25% | 143 cm² × 1.1 cm = 157 ml | 0.30 g/ml | 47 g | 250 | 118 kcal |
| Cucumber | 34% | 194 cm² × 1.1 cm = 214 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 128 g | 15 | 19 kcal |
| Cooked mushrooms | 9% | 51 cm² × 1.3 cm = 67 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 43 g | 35 | 15 kcal |
| Light oil coating | Overlaps other items | Approximately 3 ml | 0.92 g/ml | 3 g | 884 | 27 kcal |

The food footprints total **68% of the plate**; oil adds no separate footprint.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **221 g and 179 kcal** is plausible for a modest bread slice with a generous scattering of cucumber and a smaller quantity of mushrooms. The oil quantity and plate size are the main uncertainties.
